title: Windows B: review-attempt export directory rename refused with EPERM in three fingerprint-stage tests
outcome: The review-attempt exporter's immutable directory publication either works on Windows B or its refusal is explained by a named, evidenced cause, so the fingerprint stage does not fail there for an unexplained reason.
acceptance: The cause of the EPERM directory rename on Windows B is classified from discriminating evidence as product, test/runner, or environment.

If product or test: a fix lands with a test that reproduces the refusal deterministically, and scripts/export-review-attempt.test.mjs passes on Windows B in a launcher run on the fixed tree. If environment: the condition is named with evidence and its remedy is recorded as Greg's decision.

completion.summary: Classified as product: the exporter's one-shot directory rename failed on a brief Windows hold. Fixed with a bounded wait on Windows sharing errors, a matching wait in fixture removal, and deterministic real-handle tests. The holder is not named. Landed in 7f8d1b63 with Windows B FULL test-78f5f61f green.
